phase_0_branch.interpretation: Sensitivity scenarios only; not a probability statement, calibration result, or compliance claim.

completed_prerequisites: null-floor-aware sector-selective protected-tone fallback with exact safety and floor audit
remaining_authorization_prerequisites: practical 64T64R or hybrid architecture mapping with realizable degrees of freedom, quantization, and null floor
independent review of one immutable phase-1 campaign bundle
source-referenced measurement data if practical compatibility or compliance language is intended
primary_hypothesis: Under identical information, delay, slew, traffic, criterion, and declared engineering-envelope conditions, robust predictive constrained-PF control with a sector-selective fallback achieves zero hard-safety violations and a positive paired fairness-utility advantage over safe static, delayed-myopic, virtual-queue, common-scale, hard-null, and uniform-backoff baselines.

phase_1_paired_primary.replication_unit: channel/topology seed crossed with protected pass
phase_1_paired_primary.criterion: joint long-term design with separately reported short-term verification
phase_1_paired_primary.array: practical 64T64R or hybrid primary after architecture mapping

phase_2_factor_sensitivities.rule: Run one factor block at a time using paired common random numbers; do not execute the full Cartesian product.

phase_3_confirmatory_holdout.rule: Freeze algorithms, architecture, thresholds, scenario matrix, and primary metrics before opening this block.

primary_endpoints: hard-safety violation count and maximum excess
statistics.go_condition: All hard-safety checks pass with no hidden slack and the paired predictive-versus-safe-static fairness-utility confidence interval excludes zero.
